⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Regenerated docs now under-report runtime writes/side effects**

This line used to be preceded by `-  - \`input/<KEY>/merge_conflicts.md\``; the regenerated docs for all 7 pre-CLI actions dropped that entry (and `test_case_automation.md` additionally dropped the `git merge` side effect). The deletion is a static-scan artifact, not a behavior change:

- `js/preCliStoryTestAutomationSetup.js:47` still delegates to `branchSetup.writeBranchConflictGuidance(...)`, which writes `input/<KEY>/merge_conflicts.md` at runtime.
- `js/preCliTestAutomationSetup.js` still runs `git merge-tree` via `branchSetup.collectMergeTreeDetails` (on main the generator matched the `git merge-tree` literal as a "git merge" side effect).

So the generated docs — which agents and humans read to understand what each action touches — are now factually wrong in the "less info" direction. Suggest a follow-up: either teach `js/agentDocGenerator.js` to follow `require`s into `js/common/` when attributing `file_write`/`cli_execute_command` calls, or hand-annotate the affected sections. Non-blocking since runtime behavior is unchanged and pinned by the characterization suites.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Two "canonical" tracker-holder implementations now coexist**

The docblock claims the canonical implementation lives here ONCE, but `js/common/trackers.js:1536` still exports its own `createTrackerHolder()` — used by ~20 action files (`grep -rn "createTrackerHolder" js --include="*.js"` shows `retryMergePR.js`, `recoverStuckDevelopment.js`, `checkWipLabel.js`, `developTicketAndCreatePR.js`, etc.), while only `preCliTestAutomationSetup.js` and `prepareTestPRForReview.js` migrated to this new module. Both factories implement the same lazy-singleton-with-reinit semantics, so any future fix (e.g. to null-normalization) must be applied in two places or the behaviors silently diverge.

I understand the migration was deliberately limited to 2 SUTs to stay under the 50-token clone window — that's fine for this ticket. Please file a follow-up ticket to consolidate `trackers.js::createTrackerHolder` onto this require-free module (or vice versa) so the "canonical ONCE" claim becomes true.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
💡 **SUGGESTION: `|| 'main'` fallback is new behavior for the story-setup caller**

`checkoutTestBranchHead` fetches `[branchName, (config.git && config.git.baseBranch) || 'main']`. The preCliTestAutomationSetup original had exactly this fallback, but `preCliStoryTestAutomationSetup.js`'s original `checkoutBranch` built the fetch list as `[branchName, config.git.baseBranch]` — no `'main'` default (see `origin/main:js/preCliStoryTestAutomationSetup.js:209`). In practice `config.git.baseBranch` is always set, so the deviation is unreachable-ish, but it slightly contradicts the PR's "exact commands unchanged" claim. If the fallback is intentional hardening, a one-line comment here would make that explicit.

comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
💡 **SUGGESTION: unmentioned behavior change — stale-branch deletion now runs even when the ticket move fails**

Before the extraction, `finalizeAlreadyMergedTestCase` wrapped the label+move+comment **and** the `git push origin --delete` in one `try` — if `getTracker().getIssue`/`moveToStatusOrMark` threw, the branch deletion was skipped. Now `moveMergedTicketAndReport` swallows its own errors and the deletion below always executes. This is arguably an improvement (a merged test branch is stale regardless of tracker-move success), but it is a real behavior change not noted in the PR description. Consider one sentence in the docblock, or restore the old skip-on-failure coupling if it was deliberate (e.g. keeping the branch for investigation when the move fails).
